stem_text: Velocity-time graph for a body of mass 10 kg is shown in figure. Work-done on the body in first two seconds of the motion is : [FIG-stem-1]
figure_reference: [FIG-stem-1] Velocity-time graph unverified against authentic master

candidate_solve.derivation: Work done equals change in kinetic energy: W = Delta KE = 1/2 m (v_2^2 - v_0^2). Coaching solution reports v_0 = 50 m/s and v_2 = 40 m/s, yielding W = 1/2 * 10 * (40^2 - 50^2) = 5 * (1600 - 2500) = -4500 J (Option C). However, the initial velocity and acceleration slope cannot be independently verified without the authentic diagram asset.
